home.t003: A clean canvas. A personal touch.
home.t006: THE BEAUTY OF A CLEAR CANVAS
home.t009: A transparent case. Your phone’s own color. A signature that makes the everyday feel personal.
home.t012: A clear canvas keeps your phone’s shade in view.
home.t015: A name, a style, a small detail that feels like you.
home.t031: THREE SMALL STEPS. ONE PERSONAL TOUCH.
home.t064: Try a look here. Your saved design stays unchanged.
home.t068: A closer look at the visual idea:
home.t069: a clear canvas, considered lettering, your own placement.
home.t072: The transparent look makes the phone’s color part of your design.
home.t076: Six lettering styles bring a different rhythm to the same name.
home.t080: Centered, vertical or angled. Explore where your signature feels at home.
home.t081: Design study. Product photography and construction details to be confirmed.
home.t096: The things we carry become part of our days. A familiar color. A favorite word. A name in a hand that feels like our own.
home.t097: This is the idea behind Lumasela: a little space for personal expression, in something you reach for every day.
home.t102: Some of our most personal objects are also the most familiar. They sit beside a morning coffee, come along on a walk and stay close through an ordinary day. Over time, their small details begin to feel like ours.
home.t103: For Lumasela, the creative starting point is a clear canvas. Let the phone’s color remain part of the picture. Add a name, choose its lettering and find a place for it. Each choice is small, but together they create a look that feels personal.
home.t104: A flowing line or a bolder mark. A quiet shade or a little contrast. There is room to explore, and room to keep it simple.
home.t105: That is the feeling this collection is imagined around: something familiar, with a little more of you in it.
home.t111: Explore your name, lettering style, text color and placement in the customizer.
home.t112: Can I try a style before I decide?
home.t114: Yes. Choose any signature above, then adjust it on the design page. Your name stays yours when you switch styles.
home.t115: Can I come back to my design?
home.t117: Your choices are kept in this browser tab while you explore. Return to the design page to continue.
home.t118: How do I add my design to the bag?
home.t120: Review your design on the product page, then add an available variant to your shopping bag. Product information and availability come from the store listing.
home.t121: Where can I ask about delivery and returns?
home.t123: Delivery, returns and terms have not yet been provided for this preview.
